curated.tagline: iMessage in the Omarchy bar, with your Mac as the gateway
curated.description: Omarchy bar widget that reads and sends iMessage from Linux, including group chats, read receipts and desktop toasts. A Mac signed into Apple ID acts as the gateway over SSH; the Linux side is a thin QuickShell and Bun client.
highlights: Read, send and group chats from a Linux bar popout
Mac-over-SSH gateway instead of reimplementing iMessage
Dims and waits gracefully when the Mac sleeps
curated.architecture: Mac (Messages) → SSH gateway → Bun client → QuickShell bar widget
